recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑之間造血組織明顯多於脂肪，局部細胞量偏高（以老年人而言屬於過度增生），並散在巨核細胞；高細胞量合併周邊血球減少，是 MDS 評估中需先注意的低倍線索。
features: Low-power core biopsy with bony trabeculae and intertrabecular marrow spaces
Increased cellularity centrally (roughly 60-70%) with less cellular subcortical areas
No lymphoid aggregates, granulomas, fibrosis, or tumor infiltrates at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows intertrabecular marrow spaces with increased cellularity for age, estimated at approximately 60-70% in the central area, with less cellular subcortical regions. Trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered megakaryocytes is present. No lymphoid aggregates, granulomas, or infiltrating lymphoma are seen at this magnification, which is relevant to the PCNSL staging context. The hypercellular marrow in a patient with cytopenias is compatible with a myelodysplastic neoplasm, confirmed on higher-power and aspirate evaluation as MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoma involvement shows lymphoid aggregates or interstitial infiltrates, none of which are seen in this field.
MPNs show hypercellularity with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and often fibrosis, with blood counts elevated rather than cytopenias.
These show markedly decreased cellularity, opposite to the increased cellularity here.
